text_block_list.text:
Seeing that Winning Ticket didn't look 
well, I brought her to the nurse's 
office...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm sorry... I'll make sure to 
get plenty of rest and get better!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Well then, good ni—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Guuughhh... Zzzz...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ――Huh!? H-Huh... huh...!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Where... am I...? What was I doing 
again...???

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still... It's such a pretty 
place~! The grass and the breeze feel so 
soft and rustly...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Running at full blast with everything 
I've got sounds sooooo good!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! Let's go for a run right 
away! Here I gooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wahoooooo!! This is so much fuuun~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna keep running forever and 
eveeeer~~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —*pacing around nervously...*

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Gasp...!!!! Wait, this isn't a meadow, is 
it!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I see! That was just a dream...!
choice_data_list: Did you have a good dream?
Did you have a good dream?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I had the absolute beeeest dream! 
Thanks to that, my body and heart feel 
totally refreshed~!

Winning Ticket laughs happily. It seems 
she was able to get plenty of rest.
(—*rustle rustle!!*)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —Bwubaaahhh!?!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my legs got caught in the grass...!? 
And what's more! I'm sliding! Further and 
further doooown!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-It won't stooooop~~!! He~~~~lp 
meeeeee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —Uhyaah!! H-Huh...? Am I... alive...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hauaaaaa~... T-That was so scaryyy~...!

It seems Winning Ticket wasn't able to get 
enough rest...
